_about: One entry per ESPN-sourced competition, read by fetch_espn_feeds.py (the shared feed engine). Adding a league = adding an entry here (+ an entry in feeds/manifest.json for the health check and badge). Keep 'output', 'team_prefix', team slugs and 'uid_prefix' stable once live: they are subscribers' URLs and calendar event ids. 'order': 'away_at_home' (Away @ Home) or 'home_vs_away' (Home vs Away). Text fields may use {team}.
